who: Anna, 34, office job in Munich, lifts three times a week, wants to build muscle. Read Worthy Numbers, got a code from her coach Milan, opens Chef Mealan for the first time.
goal: From the first screen to tomorrow's meals planned, and Today making sense.
result: She got there: a planned Friday with three meals, and Today showed tomorrow's plan. About 42 taps and 10 minutes (the shortest path is about 22 taps and 5 minutes). But the finished day is 540 kcal under her target, and nothing tells her.
build: 0.2.73, the local build without accounts and without the AI (sign-in and the code step skipped).
steps: Welcome. Taps I'm 18 or older, let's start.
Setup with the privacy card. Taps I agree.

Training: Moderate, three days, 45 to 60 minutes.

Picks breakfast from the starter meals. Every row says fits.
All three slots set: 1,610 of 2,150 kcal, and nothing warns her.

Back on Today: tomorrow's plan, training in the evening.
The chef button: answer the question on your profile first.
findings: Setup says 6.0 PD, Today says target 5.6 and later 6.3, Plan says of 5.6 PD under a header that says PD 6.3, Me says 6.0 PD a day. The math is right (week average, training day, rest day), but no label says which day a number is for.
Always name the day: Friday target: PD 5.6 (training day). Label the header PD as today, or drop it.
A finished day is 540 kcal short, and nothing says so
After three meals: all slots set, 1,610 of 2,150 kcal. Starter meals have fixed portions, so the promise Chef Mealan tells you how much is not kept. She will undereat while building muscle.
When the day is set and kcal is more than 10 % off: 540 kcal short. Add a snack or make portions bigger, and offer to scale the meals to their slots.
Every meal fits, and the big number has no name
Sarma 410 kcal · 21 g protein 5.1 fits, with her target at 5.6. The big blue number has no PD next to it.
Write PD 5.1. Say fits only when it fits; otherwise low protein or too big.
Lunch and dinner still say It needs about 717 kcal and 40 g of protein after breakfast is set.
Show what is left for the open slots.
Training days are guessed without asking
She said three moderate days; the app put them on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday · evening, from a Training week she never saw. Moving two took 10 taps, and the new days lost the evening time.
In setup, after the count, seven day chips to tap. Or: We guessed Mon, Tue, Thu. Change.

2. The formula, Mifflin St Jeor, Katch McArdle, Schofield gives 9 kcal more at rest, the Compendium of Physical Activities.
Keep Automatic; put the rest behind How we calculate.

3 planned meals, 0 foods. Make shopping list is grey with no reason, and it says the day after your last list with no list yet.
Say why (starter meals have no ingredients yet), or give starters their ingredients; drop last list on the first list.

Answer the question on your profile first: is any of this true for you? No link; the question sits at the bottom of Profile.
Ask it in setup right after I agree, or let the banner open the question.

Merge the empty cards; hide Earlier before her first day.
